notes.title: Version 4.1.2 is out, with a bug fix and a small new feature
notes.notes:
There was a bug in 4.1.0/4.1.1 where Cavemen could no longer see their HP changing while berserk.  That bug is fixed in this release.

I also added, by popular demand, a sorting option in the Character Selection screen.  You can sort your characters by last login (the default), by name, by race, or by level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39928211/4ed9b7f3ec5e97326d93a9c9ef9acbbe21499e11.png[/img]

Enjoy!

R

notes.title: Update notes for June 8th
notes.notes:
* Added outline borders to dialogs and popups

  * Fixed text output to not autoscroll if you are scrolled up
    - so you can go back and read text without being interrupted

  * Added new option (in View menu) to disable tooltips/hover-text

  * Builder Mode improvements:
    - Added Search function, with a fuzzy/strict slider
    - Clicking selected object gives a "Visit folder" menu option
    - Added "breadcrumbs" so you can visit anywhere in the folder path
    - Some fixes for back/forward history buttons
    - Moved the close-button to the title bar (more space-efficient)
    - Added a terrain-border toggle so you can place terrain more accurately
    - Fixed the tool buttons to show you when they are clicked/selected

  * Fixed 24-year-old bug in cursor movement in text input area
    - ctrl-b and ctrl-f were moving the cursor 2 spots instead of 1
      - the regular arrow keys worked fine for positioning the cursor
    - it's been bugging me for literally 24 years; finally found a fix

  * Also fixed longstanding bug in alt-f moving to end of last word

  * Fixed bug with leaderboards only showing even-numbered players
    - happened the first time you opened any new leaderboard

notes.title: Update notes for March 14 2021
notes.notes:
This patch contains one small new feature, and some bug fixes.

[b]New Feature: VIP Display[/b] -- You now get a little crown icon in your stat view if your account has VIP status, and if your VIP level is 2 or higher, it shows that as well.

We have changed the definition of VIP levels.  It used to be 1000 crowns was level 1, 2000 was level 2, 3000 was level 3, and so on.  Now it is easier to get to levels 2, 3, and 4, but then it's harder to get to levels 6+.  The new table will be posted on Reddit.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
  [*] Lowered default sound volume
  [*] Fixed some remaining squished-dialog issues
  [*] Added hover-text to XP bar to explain why it counts down
  [*] Fixed persistent sign-in error after server resets
  [*] Fixed chat window to not open multiple copies
  [*] Chat window now remembers where you last put it
  [*] Fixed glitch with split-chat pane disappearing
  [*] Fixed Alt-TAB back to app losing input focus
[/list]

I am still working on the Steam Overlay glitches, but have not figured out why it's happening yet.

notes.title: Dev branch 3.0.5 - bug fixes
notes.notes:
* Lowered default sound volume
  * Added VIP display in the stats view
  * Fixed some remaining squished-dialog issues
  * Added hover-text to XP bar to explain why it counts down
  * Fixed persistent sign-in error after server resets
  * Fixed chat window to not open multiple copies
  * Chat window now remembers where you last put it
  * fixed glitch with split chat pane disappearing
  * fixed Alt-TAB back to app losing input focus

This branch also includes a change that I hope will make the Steam Overlay more cooperative, but it is untested.  All this stuff is untested, which is why it's on the developer branch.

notes.title: Post-launch bug fixes
notes.notes:
This update has some minor bug fixes.

If you tried linking your Gmail account on launch day, and it said "Your accounts are linked!" but then didn't work, please try again -- it is fixed now. You do not need this update in order for it to work.

Patch notes:
[list]
[*] Better error handling when linking accounts fails for some reason
[*] Remember the position of the split-chat divider when you change it
[*] Easier-to-see Command button in lower-right
[/list]
